 Bench At Jaipur

sentences.text: For Petitioner(s) : Petitioner present in person For Respondent(s) : Mr. Atul Sharma, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE BIRENDRA KUMAR Order 21/02/2023 Heard the petitioner in person.
Let notice should go to respondent No.2 through both the processes.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the State-respondent.

The petitioner contends that a civil dispute between the parties, running before the Revenue Court is the background of the impugned FIR No.879/2021 registered with Police Station Muhana, District Jaipur for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.

Considering the aforesaid submission, it is directed that the petitioner shall not be arrested in the aforesaid FIR, till further order with condition that the petitioner shall fully co-operate with the investigation of the case.

(BIRENDRA KUMAR),J Ashwani/-28 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
